messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: last night's staged rollout caused a brief but bad p95 regression. Action items: auto-soft-rollback, default flag blast-radius, explicit canary gates, and recurrence analysis. Need owners + deadlines.

alex: Keep scope small. I'll own the epic and link the incident. Can we aim for scaffolding PRs this sprint?

tasha: I'll take flag defaults. Proposal: new flags default to server-enforced audience_pct=1 and max_active_users=1000; opt-in required for wider release. I'll draft migration.

samir: I'll own canary gating. Sketch: sliding 5m window monitor p50/p95/error-rate vs baseline. Soft rollback triggered if p95 > baseline*1.25 for 5m or error_rate > baseline*1.15. Hard rollback after 3m no recovery.

kevin: Rollback plumbing: soft = route traffic off variant automatically; hard = revert after approval. Add POST /rollouts/{id}/soft_rollback and CLI simulate cmd for tests. Also propose ROLLOUT_KILL_SWITCH env var + RBAC.

deploy-bot: deploy 2027-02-08T02:12:01Z started for release/limited-rollout

oncall-bot: incident INC-2027-14 created (p95 spike during limited rollout)

maria: Tentative deadlines: flags + migration (tasha) -> 2027-02-20; soft-rollback MVP (samir+kevin) -> 2027-02-27; hard-rollback + approvals (kevin) -> 2027-03-20; recurrence analysis (maria) -> 2027-02-22. Weekly sync Thurs 10am. Update the epic with PR links and ticket assignees. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
